rationale: X catches the shared-config mutation bug in audio_vae.py (matching the ground-truth amy-why-3459 comment) and adds a legitimate, diff-grounded bonus observation about the encode_latent path becoming stochastic, plus notes the decode-window tightening — giving it broader coverage than Y, which surfaces only the config-mutation issue. However X's narrative cites specific WER benchmark numbers (1.83% vs 2.02%, 1088 utterances) that are not present anywhere in the diff, which reads as fabricated/unverifiable evidence and dents its precision; it also fails to flag the serving_speech.py dialect-removal change as a question, unlike ground truth's amy-why-3459 comment. Y's single finding is precise, fully grounded, and highly actionable with an exact code-level suggestion, but its recall is very limited since it ignores the other three diff areas entirely.
